title: Page 138
transc:
Jno Horner  Washn Aug 1st 1864
Growler Elizabeth Aug Plug For Kasson unity
The money and pack cage concerning which
I wrangled you on Friday are Sligo
Chemical bank and not the bank of
Com - merce youth Image old nick


McCaine  Washn Aug 1st 1864
Grapes Francis Aug Plug For Mutton unity
If only Panama had pocketed a Vermont
it with Squash would be use less
Pekin More over in this extreme heat
they would soon be broken down by
a Sainted march Zebra I am fitting
out Pacific & hope to send you
several Whips Wharf and whelp yoke Italy
